description.value: Orange Julius / Dairy Queen is a combination fast-food outlet inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre, Kelowna's largest indoor mall with over 170 stores. The location serves the brand's signature Orange Julius beverages, Julius Juicers fresh-squeezed juice, and smoothies alongside Dairy Queen classics including Blizzards, DQ Cakes, and hot dogs. It sits along the busy Harvey Avenue commercial corridor, making it a convenient mid-ride refreshment stop for cyclists in the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content (Orchard Park Shopping Centre store directory) confirms this is a real, operating Orange Julius/Dairy Queen combo unit inside the mall at 2271 Harvey Avenue. The phone number 250-860-2515 and address both match OSM exactly. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content; the mall services page lists parenting rooms, seating, and wheelchairs but not washrooms or bike facilities explicitly.
concerns: OSM name field is 'Orange Julius' but the business operates as a combo unit branded 'Orange Julius/ Dairy Queen' per the website and OSM branch tag; the OSM name may be incomplete.
Website URL resolves to the shopping centre's store-directory page, not a standalone brand website — no brand-level amenity detail is available.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating fast-food business confirmed open at the stated address inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre. Useful to touring cyclists as a beverage and snack stop on the Harvey Avenue corridor.
